ns2:section.sectionText: Prerequisite: CW 100 or 104, or with instructor's advanced permission. This is an introductory class in the art of screenwriting. You’ll learn screenplay format and technique through reading craft lessons, reading screenplays, watching films, as well as through writing exercises and discussion. Meanwhile, you’ll develop a premise and an outline for your own feature-length screenplay. Next, we’ll move into full-workshop mode, and you’ll write the first act of your screenplay.
